plainTranslation: Composite Uranus in the 11 House: With Composite Uranus in the 11th house, this is the house Uranus naturally rules, so change can be something that feels more naturally-occurring in this relationship. You can find sudden insights together, make sudden progress with your dreams together, expand your networks together, and make a difference together. You can allow each other to be yourselves, and think more about your future. 81/ ​© The Dark Pixie Astrology
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
